name: @ninjapaw/committer-insights
description: Local Azure DevOps Advanced Security committer reports with Excel and CSV exports.
author: Microsoft Corporation

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start --workspace api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace app && npm run build --workspace api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace app && npm run typecheck --workspace api
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace app && npm run test:unit --workspace api
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:exe && npm run test:exe
